notes: Structured query templates for the SEO + Analytics Performance Report, migrated from the legacy generate_query/get_data_insights flow to the current TMR MCP. Two connectors: gsc (site URL account IDs) and ga4 (numeric property IDs). Field IDs are raw. Dates NOT stored — runtime resolves from today's date: 90-day window for Q1-Q4/Q6/Q7; the two most recent FULL calendar months for Q5 (GA4 MoM) and Q8a/Q8b (GSC page MoM). No currency (this report has no monetary metrics). AI-referrer filtering for Q7 is done in synthesis (pull all session sources, then keep chatgpt.com / gemini.google.com / claude.ai / perplexity.ai / copilot.com / notebooklm.google.com). All queries validated clean against live gsc + ga4 accounts. GSC data lags ~2-3 days.

queries.title: GA4 Landing Pages (90d)
queries.synthesis: take top 5 by sessions and top 5 by key events

queries.title: GA4 Landing Page x Month (last 2 full months)
queries.synthesis: month-over-month per page; best = top 5 by session increase, worst = top 5 by decrease; exclude (not set)

queries.title: GA4 Session Source (90d)
queries.synthesis: filter to known AI referrers: chatgpt.com, gemini.google.com, claude.ai, perplexity.ai, copilot.com, notebooklm.google.com (allow /referral suffix). If none present, report AI traffic as zero.
